name: purecat
description: Local AI video editor with silence detection and transcription
author: PureCat Team <team@purecat.app>

scripts.dev:electron: cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1 ELECTRON_FORCE_GPU_MEM_AVAILABLE_MB=0 electron --disable-gpu --disable-gpu-compositing --disable-software-rasterizer --disable-gpu-process-crash-limit --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-features=VizDisplayCompositor main/index.js
scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
scripts.check: node scripts/check-srt.ts && node scripts/check-cuts.ts && node scripts/check-cut-remap.ts && node scripts/check-drag.ts && node scripts/check-ass.ts && node scripts/check-render.cjs && node scripts/check-kdenlive.ts && node scripts/check-karaoke.ts && node scripts/check-premiere-titles.ts && node scripts/check-media.cjs && node scripts/check-peaks.cjs
